traditional: the Moon trine Venus: a soft contact. The body, home, and daily needs supports love, money, and pleasure - cooperation and favorable conditions in these areas.
modern: Feelings meet charm and pleasure. Warmth is expressed instinctively, with a strong love of comfort and beauty. The trine makes this a natural strength: Naturally charming and emotionally generous. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waning: Distribute and give transmissible form to what feeling and connection have realized.

business: An opening in this area. Likable and warm; watch indulgence and shaky money instincts.
shadow: The ease lets moodiness and over-need and indulgence and vanity go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: Ease and support build and arrive on their own.
arcSeparating: The ease withdraws; the flow passes, used or not.

readerCopy.body: Affection is easier to give and receive when uncomplicated care is allowed to remain uncomplicated. When the Moon trines Venus, emotional needs and pleasure reinforce each other, making connection, generosity, beauty, and ordinary comfort easier to enjoy. A good feeling does not need a hidden catch or a future contract to justify itself. The ease is useful precisely because nobody has to work so hard to make the moment kind.
